# TimeGovern
> Fast answers for money, time & code.

TimeGovern is a free tool hub for flights, car rentals, time zones, calculators, weather, and world data.

## Core Tools
- /flights — live flight search powered by Google Flights
- /flights/{ORIGIN}/{DESTINATION} — programmatic route pages (e.g. /flights/lhr/jfk)
- /cars — worldwide car rental comparison via ReefAPI
- /world-clock — live times for 15,000+ cities
- /time-zone-converter — convert times across zones
- /weather — live weather for 490+ cities
- /salary/{iso2} — country salary & tax calculators

## Top Flight Routes (examples)
- /flights/lhr/jfk — London → New York
- /flights/lhr/dxb — London → Dubai
- /flights/lhe/dxb — Lahore → Dubai
- /flights/lhr/lax — London → Los Angeles
- /flights/jfk/lax — New York → Los Angeles
- /flights/sin/syd — Singapore → Sydney
- /flights/dxb/bom — Dubai → Mumbai
- /flights/lhr/bom — London → Mumbai
- /flights/fra/jfk — Frankfurt → New York
- /flights/cdg/lhr — Paris → London

## Data Sources
- Flights: Google Flights (fast-flights), OctoTrip Flights, AgentWeb
- Cars: ReefAPI, OctoTrip Rental Cars, AgentWeb
- Weather: Open-Meteo
- Airports & cities: mwgg/Airports + global city dataset

## Editorial Standards
- All flight prices shown are live and include taxes.
- Booking links redirect to the original provider (Google Flights or partner).
- We do not sell user data.
